SELECT request.attendance_request_id, attendance.working_day, employee.employee_id, employee.employee_name,
CASE employee.department_id WHEN 1 THEN '営業部' WHEN 2 THEN '総務部' WHEN 3 THEN '人事部' END AS department_name,
attendance.actual_working_start_time AS before_start_time,
attendance.actual_working_end_time AS before_end_time,
request.requested_working_start_time AS after_start_time,
request.requested_working_end_time AS after_end_time,
request.request_type, request.request_reason
FROM tb_trn_attendance_request request
INNER JOIN tb_trn_attendance attendance
ON request.attendance_id = attendance.attendance_id
INNER JOIN tb_mst_employee employee
ON attendance.user_id = employee.employee_id
WHERE request.request_flag = #{requestFlag}
ORDER BY attendance.working_day ASC, employee.employee_id ASC, request.attendance_request_id ASC

UPDATE tb_trn_attendance AS attendance
SET actual_working_start_time = request.requested_working_start_time,
actual_working_end_time = request.requested_working_end_time
FROM tb_trn_attendance_request AS request
WHERE attendance.attendance_id = request.attendance_id
AND request.attendance_request_id = #{requestId}
AND request.request_flag = #{requestingFlag}
